articles.title: Bukele deploys thousands of soldiers to Haiti
articles.author: Pablo Meriguet
articles.content_excerpt: El Salvador’s right-wing president, Nayib Bukele, announced on October 29, that he will deploy a military force of nearly 2,000 soldiers to Haiti. The Salvadoran president has justified the measure by citing the disappearance of four Salvadoran soldiers on October 18. The Salvadoran soldiers reportedly went missing following an armed attack in Croix-des-Bouquets, near the capital Port-au-Prince, involving the armored vehicle in which they were traveling. According to some reports , the attackers used very powerful weapons and explosives. Since then, the whereabouts of the soldiers remain unknown, and it is unclear whether they are still alive. articles.title: Half a million join youth-led protests in France
articles.author: Ana Vračar
articles.content_excerpt: Saturday, October 31, opened as another day of mass mobilizations across France. For almost two months – led by high school and university student demands for stronger public education – hundreds of thousands of people have been joining demonstrations against the policies of President Emmanuel Macron and successive administrations.
